title: Project Lantern — HSR and EUMR filing analysis for Altamira's acquisition of Sorell Diagnostics
instructions:
We act for Altamira Health Technologies, Inc. on its proposed acquisition of Sorell Diagnostics B.V. Today is September 15, 2025. Using only the transaction summary, the financial and turnover data, the market share estimates and the firm's threshold reference sheet, prepare a merger-control filing analysis memo for the client's General Counsel.

The memo must:
1. United States (HSR Act): compute the value of voting securities that Altamira will hold as a result of the acquisition, showing the arithmetic; apply the size-of-transaction and (if applicable) size-of-person tests with the parties' figures; analyse whether any exemption applies (in particular the foreign issuer exemption, given that Sorell is a Dutch company); conclude whether a filing is required; state the filing fee tier; and state when the initial waiting period would expire if the filing is made on the date in the transaction summary.
2. European Union (EUMR): test Article 1(2) and Article 1(3) line by line with the parties' turnover figures, identifying which Member States count toward each limb and which do not, and apply the two-thirds rule. Conclude whether the concentration has an EU dimension and explain the consequences for timing and closing.
3. Identify substantive competition concerns from the market share data (compute combined shares where there is overlap).
4. Identify any process or conduct risks in the transaction plan before closing, and recommend what the client must change.

Cite the source document and quote the operative figures or rule text verbatim for every step.
